In detail

The broader Novoli district (built on the former Fiat/Officine Galileo industrial site, now home to a shopping mall, law courts and university faculties) is one of Florence's three officially designated Prefecture 'zone rosse' with reinforced patrols and loitering restrictions, alongside the train station and Le Cascine park. Local press reported drug-dealing arrests in the area and a resident protest over a string of muggings and thefts near a local supermarket. Coverage generally refers to 'Novoli' as a whole rather than distinguishing this specific sub-zone, so this rating is applied cautiously along the district's central Via Baracca commercial corridor. Sources checked: 055firenze.it, cocaine-dealing arrests in Novoli (2025); La Nazione, resident protest over muggings near Novoli supermarket; Firenze Post / ANSA, confirmation of official 'zone rosse' including Novoli.
